answer: A payout is split and as a result 24% arrives at settlement and the rest over 8 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The ember schedule is applied in relic and delta makes public each instalment. An farming party thus cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4664 identities would post 636 proofs and burn roughly 52 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
